display.purpose: Landing hero, search query and allotment numerals.

headline.purpose: Page-head titles on the green band.

body.purpose: All UI text; tabular lining figures.

label.purpose: Table heads, stat labels, definition terms; uppercase 0.75rem.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signage-green action button; becomes yellow inside a page-head band.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.38 0.085 160); color: oklch(0.99 0.004 120); min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.14), 0 1px 2px oklch(0.2 0.05 160 / 0.3); transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.31 0.08 160); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.40 0.09 160); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action on a white sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #fff; color: oklch(0.21 0.02 165); min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.32 0.03 160 / 0.28); border-radius: 5px; font-family: Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.25 0.04 165 / 0.07); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: oklch(0.40 0.09 160); color: oklch(0.40 0.09 160); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.40 0.09 160); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Page Head (door sign)
components.description: Full-bleed green band opening every admin page; primary action turns yellow.
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 34px 24px 30px; background: oklch(0.38 0.085 160); color: oklch(0.99 0.004 120); } .ds-head h1 { font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0; } .ds-head p { color: oklch(0.86 0.04 160); margin: 8px 0 0; } .ds-head-btn { background: oklch(0.89 0.17 95); color: oklch(0.22 0.04 95); min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; font-weight: 600; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-head-btn:hover { background: oklch(0.93 0.15 95); } .ds-head-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.89 0.17 95); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White field with strong hairline border and green focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 12px; background: #fff; color: oklch(0.21 0.02 165); border: 1px solid oklch(0.32 0.03 160 / 0.28); border-radius: 5px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px oklch(0.25 0.04 165 / 0.05); outline: none; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.50 0.018 165); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.40 0.09 160); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.40 0.09 160) 24%, transparent); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Rail item; active state is a full green fill with a yellow icon.
components.html: DashboardExaminations
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; width: 220px; padding: 12px; background: #fff; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 5px; color: oklch(0.40 0.02 165); font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.962 0.006 140); color: oklch(0.21 0.02 165); } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: oklch(0.38 0.085 160); color: oklch(0.99 0.004 120); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.40 0.09 160); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill with a dot and a word; never colour alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px 2px 8px; border-radius: 99px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(0.48 0.13 150); background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.48 0.13 150) 11%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.48 0.13 150) 28%, transparent); } .ds-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Hood Ribbon and Roundel
components.description: Department ribbon beside a name, and the yellow roundel mark.
components.css: .ds-dept { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-hood { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 15px; background: oklch(0.52 0.125 255); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 50% 74%, 0 100%); } .ds-roundel { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 2.1em; height: 2.1em; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.89 0.17 95); color: oklch(0.22 0.04 95); font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Allotment Sign
components.description: Hall, Bench, Seat as big numerals on green; the seat is yellow.
components.css: .ds-allot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 1px; background: oklch(1 0 0 / 0.2); } .ds-allot > div { background: oklch(0.38 0.085 160); color: oklch(0.99 0.004 120); padding: 22px 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-allot small { font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(0.86 0.04 160); } .ds-allot b { font-family: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', Barlow, sans-serif; font-size: 3.6rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-allot b.ds-seat { color: oklch(0.89 0.17 95); }

narrative.overview:
The interface is signage. A deep signage-green band names where you are, big semi-condensed sans numerals say where to go, and a single signal-yellow marker says "this one". Everything else is a quiet, faintly green-tinted white ground with white sheets and near-black ink.

The system is sans only (Barlow and Barlow Semi Condensed, self-hosted). It is flat and ruled: hairline green-tinted borders and shallow shadows, no glass, no gradients on type, no icon-tile cards. Ornament is limited to roundels, arrows, and the department hood ribbon.
keyCharacteristics: Green is the structure: page-head band, hero, footer, active nav item, primary action, allotment cells.
Yellow is the pointer: current thing, roundels, "your seat", primary action when sitting on green.
Numerals are the hero: big Barlow Semi Condensed figures, tabular and lining.
Two themes from one token set: a light default and a deep green-black dark slot.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks the current thing. It is never body text, link text or an icon on white; on light ground it appears only as a fill with marker-ink text. On green it may be text or stroke.

rules.name: The Green Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Green fills belong to bands, primary actions, hero, footer and the active nav item; it is not sprinkled as decoration.

rules.name: The Word And A Dot Rule
rules.body: Status badges carry a word and a dot, never colour alone.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Body sets tnum and lnum; all numerals (hall, bench, seat, tickets, dates) are tabular lining.

rules.name: The Sans Only Rule
rules.body: No serif, no monospace. --font-mono aliases the body face.

rules.name: The Print Sheet Rule
rules.body: In print, .page-head becomes black on white with a 2px black bottom rule and no clip; .card and the hall-ticket slip become white, 1px black border, square corners, no shadow. Green bands never print.

dos: Do open every admin page with .page-head and put the primary action inside it as the yellow button.
Do show hall, bench and seat as large tabular Barlow Semi Condensed numerals.
Do use yellow as a fill with marker-ink text, or on green.
Do tag every department with its hood ribbon and every status with a word and dot.
Do keep light and dark on the same tokens; add overrides only for lightness shifts.
Do print official documents black on white.
donts: Don't use a serif, monospace costume, claret or grey paper ground (the rejected earlier world).
Don't put yellow text or icons on white or paper grounds.
Don't use glass, gradient text, icon-tile cards or a four-tile metric row; summary figures are a ruled strip.
Don't add a small kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't introduce a second accent colour for decoration; extra hues belong to departments only.
